metadata.title: When You Land That 1 Kill and Valorant Acts Like It’s a Full Ace
metadata.description:
I swear I did NOT deserve this kill.
Enemy probably packing bags to uninstall.
Valorant logic: ‘One kill? Nah, let’s pretend it’s an ace.’
Click if you’ve ever been gifted luck out of nowhere!

Smash that button if your aim was AFK but the kill still hit!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
